decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the educational institution attended by Perrine Paul-Gilloteaux. Document 1 (D1S5, D1S15) explicitly states she attended 'Institut National des Sciences Appliquées de Rennes' (INSA Rennes). Document 2 (D2S2, D2S3, D2S4) explicitly states she attended the 'University of Seville'. Both documents cite the same ORCID identifier (0000-0002-4822-165X) for the individual, creating a direct contradiction. Per the instruction to 'Keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner' and treat audits as fallible, both distinct claims supported by the text are included as valid answers.
